title: C# Enums
description: An enum is a special 'class' that represents a group of constants (unchangeable variables, like final variables).

challenges.title: Create Enum
challenges.exercise: Create an enum 'Level' with values: Low, Medium, High.

challenges.title: Access Enum
challenges.exercise: Create 'Level' enum, set 'Level myVar = Level.Medium' and print it.

challenges.title: Enum Int Value
challenges.exercise: Print the integer value of Level.Medium (should be 1).
challenges.solution:
enum Level { Low, Medium, High }
Console.WriteLine((int)Level.Medium);

challenges.title: Custom Values
challenges.exercise: Define enum Status { Start=10, Stop=20 }. Print (int)Status.Stop.

challenges.title: Switch Enum
challenges.exercise: Use a switch on Level.High and print 'Is High'.
